preprocess_videos_for_minicpmv: preprocess a list of video files into pixel values and target sizes for MiniCPM-V 4.6 model input
sample_frames_from_video_metadata: sample frame indices from video metadata using duration and fps to select up to 128 frames
concat_frames_as_composite_image: concatenate multiple video frames into a single composite image arranged in a grid layout
resize_and_split_patches: resize a video frame and split it into slices and patches for high-resolution processing
reshape_tensor_by_patch_size: reshape a batched video tensor into NaViT patchified format using a given patch size
